apps.localizedDescription:
Stickreate:

A native iPhone app to create static and animated WhatsApp stickers quickly, with automatic background removal. Built with SwiftUI and Apple's Liquid Glass design language (iOS 26).

Stickers follow WhatsApp's rules exactly:

• 512 × 512 px, transparent background, no white border.
• static packs 3–30, ≤ 100 KB each.
• animated packs 3–30, ≤ 500 KB each, ≤ 10 s total, ≥ 8 ms per frame.
• never mixing static and animated stickers in one pack.
• tray icon 96 × 96 PNG, ≤ 50 KB.

Build:

The Xcode project is generated, never committed. project.yml is the source of truth.

Requires Xcode 26 (iOS 26 SDK) and a deployment target of iOS 26.0.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Encode ~5-8x faster: the animated-WebP ladder no longer burns ~24 encodes per clip (a 9s cut clip went from ~174s to ~25s) + low libwebp method.
• Video frame extraction is now batched/concurrent (was sequential, ~9s).
• Settings option: 'Expand cut-out to fill the sticker' (on/off).
• In-app Language picker (System / English / Espanol) + fully localized strings (en/es). Note: applies on reopen (iOS bundle constraint); iOS also offers per-app language in system Settings.
